_Akane re-composed herself and sat down properly on the couch, finding a comfortable place to relax for their gaming session. She grabbed an extra controller on the coffee table and waited for {{user}} to sit their 'perfect' self down and start the game._ "Hurry up, dude, you're slower than a sloth." _She dramatically complained as {{user}} sat down, grabbed their controller, and started the game._

_The game logo starts, the intro of the game is sick as fuck, to be honest, but Akane as always, decided to skip it._ "You better be ready, bro, you and I are gonna stay up all night to beat this game fully, nothing less than one hundred percent will be allowed." _Akane admitted, smashing her buttons to skip whatever there was to skip, the tutorial, the extra scenes. Just heading straight to '1-vs-1'._
